title: claudex plan artifact, version 1
description: The lead's proposed implementation plan: prose rationale plus the ordered, independently-committable steps a run will execute, with risks and open questions. Submitted for a planning phase.

protocol_version.description: The protocol major version; always 1 for this schema.

message_type.description: Discriminates this message from other protocol messages.

turn_id.description: The turn this plan is submitted for.

state_revision.description: The run-state revision this submit must compare-and-swap against.

human_context.description: Disclosed local human/agent dialogue that changed requirements this turn; null when none.

requires_human_decision.description: True only for an unresolved value choice that must escalate to the human.

decision_question.description: The concrete question for the human, else null.

plan_markdown.description: Architecture, decisions, delivery contract, and rationale; does not duplicate the structured steps, risks, or open questions.

steps.description: Ordered implementation steps; each becomes one commit and checkpoint review.

description.description: Concrete file-level work; independently implementable and committable.

tests.description: Tests this step adds or updates.

risks.description: Risks the plan carries and how they are mitigated.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions that do not block starting the plan.
